svg.title: Harsha — Developer Profile
svg.desc: A periodic table of Katta Harsha Vardhan's builds: key elements, the full table, undiscovered elements as open questions, the build-break-rebuild reaction, and a properties sheet.
svg.text: I build full-stack products, ML systems and developer tools.
Not a student who codes — a person who builds things to understand them,
then breaks them to understand them better.
No. top-left · status top-right · family at the bottom
The three builds that carry the most weight: ML, full-stack and developer tooling.
Spots synthetic speech with a Wav2Vec2 model
built in PyTorch. FastAPI backend, Docker,
Flutter front end. Final-year major project.
landing page, team portal, judging admin,
Product owner and technical decision-maker on every project. AI coding tools implement from master prompts I design.
↻ loops back to 01 — next confusing thing
coursework gathers dust · experiments do not.
